location_exception_reason: Mobile Toilet Vans are deployed nationwide across municipal, construction, and event sectors; location is a deployment site, not a product attribute or origin differentiator. Removing location from title leaves product meaning intact.
biz_exception_reason: IndiaMART's seller-type filter (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer, etc.) already exposes business classification independently; business-type words in MTV titles are redundant and do not change what is being sold.
